original_prompt: It is 1917. I am head of the current Tsarist regime in Russia. This is relative to the Bolshevik Revolution. You are my right hand. The Bolsheviks have been trying hard to overthrow us for a communist state. You have just been given extremely confidential info about their full campaign, plan, and all their inside details. You run to tell me every detail. You are long winded but tell it all. Go
